name: Greedshot
detailed_description:
Greedshot is a fast-paced, over-the-top arena FPS where you play as a mercenary trapped in the world’s most brutal reality show. Kill for cash and climb the ranks to win the ultimate reward — a date with the show’s virtual idol, FlashKiss. But be careful what you wish for.

Each run throws you into randomized missions packed with deadly enemies, explosive traps, and new objectives. Between battles, spend your hard-earned blood money in a one-choice-only shop that forces you to pick carefully: more firepower or one more chance to live?

As you rise through the ranks, you’ll unlock new arenas, weapons, and bosses — until the game turns on you. Literally.

🔥 Features

  • Stylized roguelike FPS with tight combat and high replayability

  • Co-op mode: survive together, or die as a duo

  • Procedurally generated missions — no two runs are the same

  • VTuber commentary: FlashKiss cheers, mocks, and reacts in real time

  • Tactical movement system with sliding attacks, timed dashes, and stunts

  • Story-driven ranking system: unlock more as you rise in fame

Welcome to the bloodiest show on Earth.
You're not the hero. You're the content.

short_description: Greedshot is a stylish arena shooter with co-op play, anime-inspired visuals, and a live VTuber host who reacts to your actions. Battle through fast-paced missions with roguelike elements, unlock new gear, and climb the ranks of a deadly game show.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions, 20H1 version or newer).
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 @ 3.2 GHz, with AVX, AVX2, and SSE 4.2 support required.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4 GB) or AMD Radeon R9 380 (4 GB).
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions, 20H1 version or newer).
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1400.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT.
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Greedshot is designed for a mature audience and contains elements that may not be suitable for all players. This game features violence. Players will encounter graphic combat scenarios, including the use of firearms and explosives.
